test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a code language, 'POET' is coded as ‘14-13-3-18’ and 'SOON' is coded as ‘17-13-13 12’. How will 'WRITE' be coded in the same language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30dbf680205b2ac5ef3c42da1ffec8619642030da36e21c43297a3224c70e079.png] 

The logic followed here is,

**'POET' is coded as ‘14-13-3-18’,**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/67c3855de04dc4ed226f5ae69060368113ff311de914687510f8f89613f60457.png] 

**'SOON' is coded as ‘17-13-13 12’,**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d2edf900f1770d0dc583e5af8daabe2845ee743c6d8cde5efc21bd54ffddbb93.png] 

Similarly,

**'WRITE' can be coded as,**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69259210a0c93a12d522a611a16fd4bf942303dcc035899df1e7affc3aa15101.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"****21-16-7-18-3"**.
